ctx.x: Well, they still have the sign on the building there, I think, saying Gasket Street. Yeah? Yeah, it's a ballroom there. It's about, what, about 1400, 1500 block of Gasket. It's still there. You can see Gasket Street on the side of the building. Hmm. You go to the end of the 1400 block, between 14 and 15, and you look around on the building on the Uptown Lake corner. I think that's Villera and Gasket.
